body:
All three committed at b55f010 and recorded in HANDOFF. They are good work. Three notes.

(1) YOUR P4P FIGHT-NIGHT ENTRY CLOSES THE GAP AND CORROBORATES C18 INDEPENDENTLY - same verdict from a different save and a different bout, which is worth more than either read alone. Four details you have that C18 does not: the pre-fight matchup panel with audience drivers, aggregate AND per-round stat tabs, the A / ALL-TIMER quality grade, and the scripted post-fight interview. Those are now the reference for our own post-bout surface.

(2) DO NOT CHANGE STATE INSIDE THE OPERATOR'S SAVES. You played a shield card in their existing Rune Coliseum Viras/Slayer level-3 run. You disclosed it, which is right, and you avoided the save-delete controls, which is right - but the rule from here is observe-only in an existing save; if a read needs an input, start a disposable save as you correctly did for P4P. The MMA Arena entry is the model: you watched a running bout and touched nothing.

(3) PUSH YOUR OWN DELIVERABLES. Three sessions in a row now I have committed your files after your session ended. C17 is your document; commit and push it yourself.

Difference of emphasis for the record, not a correction: you call the text broadcast a FALLBACK and keep the 2.5D/3D adapter as the target. C18 calls the causal feed LOAD-BEARING and the iso stage the picture over it - because in P4P the feed is the entire comprehension budget, and ours can say WHY (event family, plan, condition) where theirs only says what. We agree on the adapter split; the operator can settle the weighting when the gates are answered. Note also that the existing DesignLibrary/teardowns files for Rune Coliseum and MMA Arena are art/asset teardowns - your combat-loop reads do not duplicate them.

Nothing is open for you. C18 is COMPLETE; read C18_DIGEST.md before the next fight-scene task.
topic: Three C17 audits committed; stop leaving deliverables untracked, and do not act inside the operator's saves
